site.age_selection: Preserve named source calibrated point ages and [0,11700) half-open domain. Native age bounds and missing bounds remain unchanged; no age probability or calibration.

fixed_response.binding: Exact saved physical response and parameter scalars, not new quadrature or inferred basin truth. Source PPE is treated as fixed conditional input, not estimated-PPE confidence.

counting_model.one_request: One native aliquot, two actual measured literal taxa and its pair total N. Counts are assumed Binomial(N,p) conditional on the selected pair; this is a new declared counting model.
counting_model.interpretation: A confidence set for pair-relative conditional cover under fixed response/PPE, not entire vegetation cover or a Bayesian probability of the true cover.
exclusions: No pooling independent/heterogeneous aliquots into one binomial request.
No full-panel count total substituted for the pair denominator.
No simultaneous 95-interval family coverage or time-series correlation model.
No empirical field validation, historical reproduction, rights or scientific admission.
counting_model.zero_edges: No actual zero count axes occur in this source population. Retain separately identified existing synthetic API edge controls; missing taxa are refused, never zero-filled.

counts_denominator: Individual measured Betula + Poaceae grains only; never full reported pollen NISP or pooled-window count mass
